verdict.rationale: Nitrokey publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its NetHSM REST API, plus vendor-hosted Swagger UI that the docs deep-link to as API documentation. The spec covers only the NetHSM appliance: the USB keys have no REST API, and the standard docs-site OpenAPI paths return 404. It is also served only from a demo instance, with no versioning or deprecation policy. missing for 10: a machine-readable spec covering the Nitrokey USB-key product line (or an equivalent protocol schema), a spec published at a stable docs/canonical location rather than only a demo instance, a documented versioning/deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Nitrokey's NetHSM exposes a REST API described by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document
The NetHSM demo instance vendor-hosts Swagger UI over the live spec
